comment: Micronaut 5.1 on its Netty server, one controller per family under Implementation/src/main/java/implementation/routes. On lambda-emulator the application answers behind micronaut-function-aws-api-proxy, which Implementation's lambda-emulator profile adds. The suite is UnitTests/, JUnit with @MicronautTest over the application on a random port, and never reaches the image. Maven has no lockfile: micronaut-parent imports the Micronaut platform's BOM, which pins every dependency and plugin, and nothing resolves a range, so the two poms the image is built from are what pin it. upgrade moves the parent to its newest patch release, because update-parent with minor and major updates off moves nothing else, and names the versions plugin's version, which micronaut-parent does not manage. /__meta reports micronaut-core's version, which platform 5.1.5 resolves to 5.1.15, so package names micronaut-core. Refusals are Micronaut's default error body. micronaut-validation cannot stop at the first failure, so the first-error route's record orders its rules with a group sequence. Micronaut computes no ETag for an answer a handler returns, so the etag family's filter is written for it. Micronaut's CORS configuration has no path, so it covers every route and cors.scoped is skipped.

unsupported.compressed.gzip_large: The compression is the Netty server's, and micronaut-function-aws-api-proxy hands each event to the router without Netty, so the answer arrives uncompressed.
unsupported.forms.multipart: micronaut-function-aws-api-proxy reads a multipart body as a urlencoded form and finds no parts in it, so the handler's @Part tenant is missing and Micronaut answers 400.
unsupported.sse.medium: micronaut-function-aws-api-proxy buffers the whole answer, so the events arrive as one body.
unsupported.stream.ndjson: micronaut-function-aws-api-proxy buffers the whole answer, so the rows arrive as one body.

client.writer: micronaut-openapi 7.1.3, Micronaut's annotation processor for OpenAPI, which reads the controllers at compile time under -Pclient
client.generator: micronaut-openapi-generator 7.0.0, Micronaut's OpenAPI Generator templates, through micronaut-maven-plugin 5.0.2's generate-openapi-client goal

skips.cors.scoped: Micronaut's CORS configuration names origins and no path, so the policy covers every route. The per-route @CrossOrigin takes its policy as annotation constants, which would copy settings.json's policy into the source.

noHandler.cors.preflight: Micronaut's CorsFilter answers the preflight before the router runs, and no handler runs.
noHandler.errors.unmatched: Micronaut's router finds no route for the path and answers 404 with its default error body.
noHandler.errors.wrong_method: Micronaut's router answers a method the path has no route for with 405 and its default error body.
noHandler.static.file: Micronaut's static resource router serves the file from the payload directory application.properties maps to /static/**, and no handler runs.

authorized.mechanism: micronaut-security, with its filter scoped to /authorized in application.properties. A TokenValidator gives settings.json's bearer token the role @Secured asks for and any other token none, and micronaut-security answers an authenticated request that @Secured refuses with 403

baseline.builtin: The handler returns the string, which Micronaut writes as text/plain, the type its @Get produces.

body.mechanism: Bean Validation constraints on the order record, which micronaut-validation's processor compiles into the record's introspection and its interceptor runs for a parameter marked @Valid. The first-error route's record orders its rules with a group sequence, which stops at the first group that fails

cache.mechanism: micronaut-cache over Caffeine: @Cacheable on a bean's methods, which return the payload and the serial the handler answers with, and one cache per route, sized and aged by settings.json

compressed.mechanism: The Netty server's compression on the whole server, at gzip's fastest level, set in application.properties

cors.mechanism: Micronaut's CorsFilter, with a configuration built from settings.json when the server's CORS configuration is created. The configuration covers every route

errors.builtin: Micronaut's router answers a path with no route with 404 and a method the path lacks with 405, and a body the parser cannot read is a 400. A handler that returns null for a missing row is a 404. Micronaut's default error processor writes each body.

etag.mechanism: A response filter on /etag/** that serialises the body the handler returned, hashes it with SHA-1 and answers a matching If-None-Match with 304

forms.builtin: Micronaut binds the urlencoded body to the record query.many binds, and the multipart parts to the handler's parameters, the file part as a CompletedFileUpload.

headers.builtin: @Header parameters, the account converted to an int.

items.builtin: One handler per method on /items/{id}, the id an int. @Get registers a HEAD route beside the GET, and the read handler names its content type, which Micronaut's answer to HEAD otherwise lacks.

json.builtin: The handler returns the record, and Micronaut Serialization writes it with the serializer its processor generated at compile time.

middleware.mechanism: No-op @RequestFilter methods, four or sixteen of them, each a filter of its own, in a @ServerFilter class whose pattern is its route's path

query.builtin: A @QueryValue for the one value, and a record bound as a @RequestBean for the eight.

sse.builtin: The handler returns a Publisher of Event, and Micronaut writes each one's data as JSON, as one event.

static.mechanism: Micronaut's static resource router over the payload directory, mapped to /static/** in application.properties

stream.builtin: The handler returns a Publisher of each row's JSON and a newline, and Micronaut writes each one as a chunk of the body.

template.mechanism: Micronaut Views with Thymeleaf: the handler returns a ModelAndView, which micronaut-views' body writer renders
